text: Implemented ReadableArray inputs for owned, borrowed, and mutable sources across high-level numeric operations and kernel.*Into; alias checks run before all destination mutation. Mutable reshapeCopy and noncontiguous fallback now allocate one primitive output and copy logical values once. Added JVM allocation receipts, shared ping-pong/alias tests, and mutable cast/convert coverage. Kept stencil overloads explicit because its experimental ownership contract is clearer without premature deduplication. Evidence: sbt fmtCheck testAll representationProof docsCheck passed; core JVM 170, core JS 166, full browser suite 3/3; git diff --check passed.
